issues.evidence: Tibetan "འགའ་ཡང་ཡིད་མི་བདེ་མ་གྱུར" with elided subject "སེམས་ཅན" carried over from line 1 (bo-kunpal 10-41: "སེམས་ཅན་འགའ་ཡང་ཡིད་མི་བདེ་བར་ཡང་མ་གྱུར"); "人" narrows the referent to humans, while the subject is sentient beings.

"དགེ་འདུན་དོན" means the affairs/tasks of the Sangha (Skt saṅghakārya); bo-shenga 10-42 glosses it as the Sangha's activities of reading and meditation ("དགེ་འདུན་གྱི་དོན་ཀློག་སྤོང་གི་བྱ་བ"), not abstract "goals".

issues.span: 盡十方虛空的邊際，為了成辦一切有情的利益
issues.evidence: "ཕྱོགས་བཅུའི་ནམ་མཁའི་མཐས་གཏུགས་པའི" modifies "སེམས་ཅན" (beings extending to the limit of space; bo-kunpal 10-54, bo-shenga 10-54 "ནམ་མཁའི་མཐས་གཏུགས་པར…སེམས་ཅན"); the Chinese leaves the phrase as a free-standing line that can be read adverbially.
issues.fix: 為了成辦盡十方虛空邊際一切有情的利益

issues.evidence: "དེ་སྲིད" (correlative of "ཇི་སྲིད") means "for that long / as long as that", a duration (Skt tāvat); "爾時" means "at that time", turning duration into a point in time.
